caption:
Thanksgiving break is five days long. The TV doesn't have to be on for all of them.

Researchers call it the structured days hypothesis: kids' habits, screen time included, tend to drift on loose days like weekends and breaks. A little structure does a lot of the work.

The no-guilt fix: an active morning, a quiet middle, and one or two screen slots you pick ahead of time. A family movie while the turkey rests? That's a tradition.
